correctness.rationale: For beta_j=j+3q, C=q+4iq and Omega=1-12q, the rotating-frame equation reduces exactly to (j-|w_j|^2)w_j+C sum_l w_l. Both zero-mean triangles are equilibria. Exact full real Jacobian determinant factors into one neutral eigenvalue and the printed quintic. All five Hurwitz determinants were recomputed and three rational Sturm counts certify the only stable interval, with q-independent nonzero polygon shape. Reflection preserves spectra via R J^T R. Spectral attraction implies local orbital exponential attraction, not global convergence or nonlinear Hopf type. The actual packaged script was run successfully.

value.rationale: Three oscillators are the minimum nondegenerate polygon size for a zero-mean rotating solution. This is a complete exact two-transition local stability classification of both chirality states along the naturally coupling-compensated linearly spaced growth-rate family. A bounded attracting interval amid unstable regimes establishes geometric-vs-spectral separation and demonstrates that triangular polygonal states can have open attracting basins; the motivating paper offers sampled rather than exact results in a different parameter slice.
